//SiteBanner: Notice strip across the top of every page. An empty Message means no banner, which is the
normal state. Variant is info, warning or error. Visitors can dismiss it, and the dismissal
is keyed by a hash of the text, so editing Message shows it to everyone again.
In a container: SiteBanner__Message, SiteBanner__Variant, SiteBanner__LinkText, SiteBanner__LinkHref.
